messages:
Alex Kim: FYI, Hartwell Med sent an RFI this morning. Key asks: POC in 2-3 weeks, PCI + regional data residency, HSM integration details, and a capability comparison for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. They attached 'Hartwell_RFI_v2.pdf'.

Priya Desai: Copy. Do they want workload isolation per tenant or just data-at-rest isolation? That will change Dedicated sizing and cost.

Alex Kim: Their note: 'isolation for patient PHI workloads; may use shared infra if logical separation + encryption meets audits'. So logical isolation + HSM preferred.

Omar Nadeem: We can support that with Dedicated + dedicated namespace + per-customer KMS keys. For Private, we offer PKCS#11 HSM gateway and optional air-gapped appliance. Need to ask whether they need HSM attestation (certificate) or just KMS/HSM API compatibility.

Priya Desai: Good point. I'll send a clarifying question: "Do you require HSM attestation (e.g., FIPS 140-2/3 cert) or is integration with their KMS sufficient?"

Legal Bot: Note: if they require attestation, include contract language for indemnity and audit support. Also flag potential export-control clauses if models are run on-prem.

Alex Kim: POC plan suggestion (high-level):
- T0: kickoff + NDA and data plane scoping (2 days)
- T1: allocate Dedicated pool (2 x A100 equiv) + network peering (3 days)
- T2: deploy sample model + ingest synthetic dataset (2 days)
- T3: run functional + perf tests (48 hrs)
- T4: deliver security artifact bundle + questionnaire responses (1 day)
Estimated calendar: ~12 business days once infra approvals and creds ready.

Priya Desai: They also want pricing bands: per-token hosted, monthly reserved for Dedicated (3 commit levels), and Private license + deployment + annual ops. I'll draft three bands with assumptions on concurrency and avg seq length.

Omar Nadeem: For the capability matrix, include rows: encryption in transit, encryption at rest, per-customer KMS keys, HSM attestation, SOC2, pen test date, data purge API, model verifiability, canary rollout, latency SLO (p50/p95/p99), throughput (req/s), supported quantizations, and rollback primitives.

Alex Kim: Also add 'SIEM integration' and 'audit log retention windows' 3 and 7 years options. Hartwell asked about 7 years for audit logs for clinical compliance.

Priya Desai: I'll prepare: hartwell_capability_matrix.xlsx and hartwell_pricing_summary.pdf. Planning to include a short assumptions sheet (concurrency, avg tokens, retention). Draft by tomorrow EOD.

Omar Nadeem: Infra asks: are we allowed to use their VPC peering or must we use a reverse-proxy? Peering speeds up transfer but some security teams forbid it. If peering is denied, we'll propose a dedicated NAT with strict egress rules.

Priya Desai: I'll include two POC network options in the doc. Also adding a note on data ingress validation and PII redaction steps.

Legal Bot: Uploading template clauses for attestation, audit access, and data handling. File: legal_attest_clauses.docx.

Infra Bot: Uploaded quick HSM checklist: hsm_integration_checklist.md and sample network diagram: hartwell_poC_network.svg.

Alex Kim: Action items: @Priya draft matrix & pricing (EOD tomorrow), @Omar finalize infra checklist + time estimate (day after), @Legal Bot supply any contract redlines we'd likely need. We'll do a quick sync at 10am tomorrow. Ping me if blockers.

Priya Desai: Thanks. I'll ping with draft links when ready.
